title: Create a Directory
shortDescription: Develop a directory list of providers that meets your selected criteria
body:
![]()

In the Create a Directory module, you can develop a directory list of providers that meets your selected criteria.  In the left sidebar navigation panel, click on Broker Tools and then select Create a Directory.  

The Create a Directory search criteria fields will be displayed.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_1.png)

## Search Criteria

### Geography

Through Create a Directory, you can search providers within a radius of 1-25 miles of one zip code. First, in the Within text box enter the number of miles (from 1 to 25 miles) that you desire the radius to be. Then, enter the specific zip code.

### Network

Select one network from the Network dropdown list of available networks.

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_2.png)
